paragraphs.text:
Y ou can try one of the following rolls once per day until you 
succeed. Or you can relax for a while. 
• With a successful Spot Hidden roll, go to 479. 
• Succeed with a Listen roll and go to 469. 
• Succeed with a Pyschology roll and go to 458. 
• With a successful Cthulhu Mythos roll, go to 477. 
Or you can go to any Bremen Location.
(457, 458, 461, 479)
